sources.name: Establishment and Modification of National Forest Boundaries: A Chronologic Record, 1891–1985 (USDA Forest Service, Lands Staff, 1985), PDF page 46

Presidential Executive Orders, Numbered 1-8030, 1862-1938 (WPA Historical Records Survey, 1944), vol. 1, list entry 2160: April 6, 1915, Santa Fe National Forest, N. Mex., enlarged by the addition of all lands of the Jemez and Pecos National Forests

Davis, The National Forests of the United States (Encyclopedia of American Forest and Conservation History, App. I, 1983), Forest History Society PDF; compiled partly from an earlier edition of the Forest Service chronologic record, so secondary corroboration only

review.note: Executive Order 2160, April 6, 1915 (effective July 1, 1915), Wilson. Davis: established by combining the Jemez and Pecos forests. The 1944 list summary says "enlarged," but no earlier Santa Fe NF appears in either source, so "established" stands.
